//functionTimeout: Hard platform kill. Must exceed INGESTION_INVOCATION_BUDGET_MS so the pipeline yields voluntarily before the platform intervenes. 10 minutes is the Consumption plan maximum.

queues.//batchSize: Per-instance concurrency. Each concurrent chunk holds a Postgres connection; keep modest and front the database with a pooler.
